# E05 函数一致连续的定义

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E05Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("函数一致连续的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E05_1_1", "一致连续要求对任意正的误差，都能选一个适用于整个定义域的距离阈值。", "", tts_text="一致连续要求对任意正的误差，都能选一个适用于整个定义域的距离阈值。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\forall\varepsilon>0,\ \exists\delta>0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E05_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E05_1_2", "对定义域中的任意两点，只要距离小于这个阈值，函数值之差就小于误差。", "", tts_text="对定义域中的任意两点，只要距离小于这个阈值，函数值之差就小于误差。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"|x-y|<\delta\Rightarrow|f(x)-f(y)|<\varepsilon", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E05_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E05Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("函数一致连续的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E05_2_1", "逐点连续可以为每个固定点选择不同阈值；一致连续要求阈值与点的位置无关。", "", tts_text="逐点连续可以为每个固定点选择不同阈值；一致连续要求阈值与点的位置无关。")
        line_1 = Text("同一个 delta 适用于全域", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E05_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E05_2_2", "例如 x 平方在整个实数轴上不一致连续。取 x n 为 n，y n 为 n 加 n 分之一。", "", tts_text="例如 x 平方在整个实数轴上不一致连续。取 x n 为 n，y n 为 n 加 n 分之一。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"x_n=n,\quad y_n=n+\frac1n", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E05_2_2")
        self.start_cue("E05_2_3", "两点距离趋于零，但函数值之差趋于二。", "", tts_text="两点距离趋于零，但函数值之差趋于二。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"|y_n^2-x_n^2|=2+\frac1{n^2}\to2", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E05_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E05Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("函数一致连续的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E05_3_1", "例题：判断函数 f x 等于二 x 在实数轴上是否一致连续。", "", tts_text="例题：判断函数 f x 等于二 x 在实数轴上是否一致连续。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"f(x)=2x", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E05_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E05_3_2", "两点函数值之差等于两倍的自变量距离。", "", tts_text="两点函数值之差等于两倍的自变量距离。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"|f(x)-f(y)|=2|x-y|", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E05_3_2")
        self.start_cue("E05_3_3", "给定任意正误差，选择 delta 等于误差的一半，就对所有点有效。", "", tts_text="给定任意正误差，选择 delta 等于误差的一半，就对所有点有效。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\delta=\frac{\varepsilon}{2}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E05_3_3")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E05Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("函数一致连续的定义", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E05_4_1", "判断一致连续的关键是一个统一阈值，而不是每个点分别有一个阈值。", "", tts_text="判断一致连续的关键是一个统一阈值，而不是每个点分别有一个阈值。")
        line_1 = Text("量词顺序与阈值独立性", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E05_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E05_4_1")
```
